plan.title: lint-docs test resolves its script with URL.pathname; use fileURLToPath so paths with spaces work
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.docsJustification: The change edits only how tests/unit/scripts/lint-docs.test.ts locates scripts/lint-docs.js; no user-facing page, docs/ file, CLAUDE.md section, or rule documents that, and the issue's acceptance criteria require no documented-surface change.

narratives.Problem: tests/unit/scripts/lint-docs.test.ts line 11 builds SCRIPT with new URL('../../../scripts/lint-docs.js', import.meta.url).pathname. URL.pathname keeps percent-encoding, so a checkout path containing a space yields '%20' in SCRIPT; execFileSync('node', [SCRIPT, ...]) then targets a nonexistent file and the three lint-docs CLI tests fail. Even if the file were found, scripts/lint-docs.js line 139 compares fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) to process.argv[1], so an encoded argv would never match isMain.
narratives.Proposal: Import fileURLToPath from node:url (after the node:path import) and define SCRIPT as fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../scripts/lint-docs.js', import.meta.url)), matching scripts/lint-docs.js. See .pan/drafts/PAN-4548.md work item 1 for exact before/after hunks.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not edit tests/unit/scripts/vendor-okf-skill.test.ts, tests/unit/scripts/lint-dist-externals.test.ts, or tests/unit/scripts/canonicalize-circular-deps.test.ts, even though they use the same .pathname pattern; they belong in a follow-up issue.
- Do not change scripts/lint-docs.js or any production code.
- Do not add a new regression test or a spaced-path checkout harness.
- Do not add or change any documentation file, including .overdeck/context/codebase/conventions.md.
- Do not reformat or reorder unrelated lines of the test file.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix only tests/unit/scripts/lint-docs.test.ts; leave the three sibling test files with the same .pathname pattern for a follow-up issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue title, body, and acceptance criteria name exactly one file; surgical-change rules forbid widening scope silently.

autoDecisions.summary: No new regression test for spaced paths.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reproducing requires a second full checkout with node_modules at a spaced path; the existing three CLI tests plus grep checks verify the change, and a planning-time node probe proved the encoding difference.

autoDecisions.summary: No documentation change; set plan.metadata.docsJustification instead of a docs item.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's third acceptance criterion states no documented surface changes and the PR must say so.

items.title: Resolve SCRIPT in lint-docs.test.ts with fileURLToPath

expected_outputs: vitest exits 0 and reports every test in lint-docs.test.ts passing, including the three lint-docs CLI tests

narrative.Action: In tests/unit/scripts/lint-docs.test.ts: (A) add the line import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'; directly after import { join } from 'node:path';. (B) Replace line 11, const SCRIPT = new URL('../../../scripts/lint-docs.js', import.meta.url).pathname;, with const SCRIPT = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../scripts/lint-docs.js', import.meta.url));. Touch nothing else. The PR description must state 'No documented surface changes.' Note: npm run typecheck excludes *.test.ts, so use eslint and vitest as evidence.

items.title: Given the edited tests/unit/scripts/lint-docs.test.ts, when grepped, then it imports fileURLToPath from node:url, defines SCRIPT with fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../scripts/lint-docs.js', import.meta.url)), and grep -c '\.pathname' returns 0
When npx vitest run tests/unit/scripts/lint-docs.test.ts runs, then the command exits 0 and reports all tests in the file, including the three lint-docs CLI tests, as passed
Given the PR for PAN-4548, then its diff touches only tests/unit/scripts/lint-docs.test.ts and its description states that no documented surface changes
